faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Help
faq.help_desc: Our team replies by email within 2 business days.
faq.a1: An online directory and catalogue of Algerian industrial suppliers. Buyers find verified companies and their products there and contact them directly.
faq.q2: Is the site free for buyers?
faq.a2: Yes. Browsing the catalogue, comparing products and contacting a supplier is free. An account is required for messaging and favourites.
faq.a3: The company provided its trade register and tax ID and our team checked them. The badge confirms it legally exists; it does not guarantee product quality, so always check the quote and terms of sale.
faq.q4: How do I contact a supplier?
faq.a4: From a product or company page: through the platform's messaging, or by WhatsApp if the supplier provided it. From the comparison page you can also send a quote request to several suppliers at once.
faq.q5: How do I register my company?
faq.a5: Create a “Supplier” account, confirm your email address, then upload your trade register and tax ID from your dashboard. Once the file is approved, you can publish your products.
faq.q6: How many products can I publish?
faq.a6: 5 with the free plan, 15 with Basic and unlimited with Pro. Details are on the Pricing page.
faq.a7: Subscriptions are invoiced in dinars, VAT included. You pay by bank transfer or cheque against the invoice, or online with a CIB / Edahabia card when available.
faq.q8: How will I know my file has been reviewed?
faq.a8: Our team reviews each file and emails you its decision. If it is rejected, the reason is given so you can correct and resend your documents.

faq.q1: How do I list my company in the directory?
faq.a1: Sign up with the “Supplier” profile, then submit your legal documents (trade register, tax ID) from your dashboard. Once our team has verified them, your profile and products are published.
faq.a2: The free plan lets you publish 5 products. Basic (18,000 DZD incl. VAT per year) allows 15, and Pro (29,900 DZD incl. VAT per year) is unlimited with support within 24 h. You subscribe and pay by bank transfer or CIB / Edahabia card from the Subscription tab of your dashboard.
faq.q3: How do I contact a supplier?
faq.a3: Use the contact button on a company or product page. Your conversations are then grouped in the messages section of your dashboard.
faq.q4: Is the platform available outside Algeria?
faq.a4: Yes, Algeria Industry aims to connect Algerian industry with the whole world. The platform is available in French, Arabic and English.
